principle: PPO training/development workloads and the final PPO-vs-HPA evaluation workload are disjoint. The final evaluation workload must remain unopened/unexecuted until PPO training and all methodology choices in this phase are frozen. No final-evaluation outcome may be used to tune PPO.

training_and_development_workloads.status: CANDIDATE profiles already on disk, previously described in docs/rl_mdp_spec.md sec.22 as 'candidate, NOT yet frozen' for training/validation use -- Phase16U now designates all six as the training/development set for PPO

profiles.name: mixed
profiles.role: training (primary comparison scenario per its own file header)

training_and_development_workloads.episode_scheduling_rule: round-robin cycle through the 6 profiles in a fixed order, reshuffled once per full cycle using the frozen training seed (42); repeated cyclically until the training budget (phase_16u_ppo_hyperparameters.json) is exhausted

periodic_in_training_dev_validation.purpose: save_best checkpointing signal only -- never used to select final reported metrics, never a substitute for the final held-out evaluation

training_and_development_workloads.used_during_earlier_MDP_design: yes -- burst/ramp/step peak RPS values (70/60/50) already informed the frozen request_rate_norm clip ceiling (docs/rl_mdp_spec.md sec.7/22). This is acceptable because these are explicitly the TRAINING set, not the held-out evaluation set -- the leakage concern in sec.22 applies only to workloads claiming held-out status.

excluded_from_the_formal_final_compariso.reason: docs/rl_mdp_spec.md sec.22 revoked its eligibility as the sole formal final held-out evaluation profile after finding its 80 RPS burst magnitude had already informed the request_rate_norm normalization design (an information leak, even though the final clip value was re-justified without reference to it). Phase16U does not reuse it for the FORMAL PPO-vs-HPA comparison. The file itself remains untouched, unexecuted, and unmodified -- consistent with the frozen contract's own instruction ('not deleted, not rewritten, not run').
excluded_from_the_formal_final_compariso.optional_non_formal_use: MAY be run once, post-hoc, purely as an additional diagnostic data point after the formal comparison is complete and reported -- never as part of the primary decision rule, and never inspected/used before then.

final_evaluation_workload.status: NOT YET CREATED. This section is a frozen GENERATION SPECIFICATION only -- Phase16U does not create, inspect, or run this workload. It performs the workload-freeze step required (but not yet completed) by docs/rl_mdp_spec.md sec.22: 'a dedicated workload-freeze phase ... must define a NEW formal held-out evaluation workload ... distinct from anything inspected during state/reward design.'
final_evaluation_workload.seed_justification: distinct from all training-profile seeds (42) and from unseen_eval.yaml's seed (99) -- never previously used anywhere in this project

shape_specification.structure: multi-phase, deliberately combining elements not present together in any single training profile

phases.note: slow ramp, shallower slope than ramp.yaml's 3->60 over 400s
burst riding on top of an already-elevated baseline -- no training profile bursts from a non-trivial baseline

shape_specification.peak_rps_justification: below the 100 RPS observation clip ceiling with margin; deliberately NOT equal to unseen_eval.yaml's 80 RPS peak or to any training profile's peak (70/60/50/45/20/5), to avoid any perceived reuse of a previously-inspected magnitude

final_evaluation_workload.hash_pinning_requirement: once this file is actually created (implementation phase), its SHA-256 must be computed and hash-pinned before the very first evaluation episode reads it -- mirroring the Iteration-3 protocol/schedule hash-pinning discipline
final_evaluation_workload.inspection_before_use_forbidden: no phase, including the implementation phase, may inspect this workload's generated traffic trace or run it against any controller before both PPO training and this entire Phase16U protocol are frozen and unchanged

final_evaluation_design.sample_size_disclosure: n=3 per controller does not support a formal statistical significance test; the decision rule in phase_16u_direct_ppo_protocol.yaml Section 10 is deliberately conservative and non-inferential for this reason.
